items.title: Bloomberg This Weekend 8/29/2026
items.content: <article>The news doesn’t stop when markets close. Hosts David Gura, Christina Ruffini and Lisa Mateo bring clarity, context and a bit of humor to the weekend’s biggest headlines, LIVE from New York. Joined by Schwab Head of Macro Research and Strategy Kevin Gordon, Allspring Global Investments Head of Equity Investments Ann Miletti, Child Online Safety Activist Beeban Kidron and Content Creator Macy Gilliam. (Source: Bloomberg)</article>

items.title: Meta Child Safety Deal Puts Rivals on Notice
items.content: <article>Meta’s child safety settlement includes new protections for young users and is increasing pressure on other social media platforms to adopt similar safeguards. UK House of Lords National Security Strategy Committee member and Online Safety Activist Baroness Beeban Kidron is on Bloomberg This Weekend and says the bigger impact may come from forcing technology companies to take greater responsibility for product design and age verification, rather than relying on children and parents to protect themselves.  (Source: Bloomberg)</article>

items.title: Inside the Dangote Family Vision and the Next Era of African Industry
items.content: <article>What does the future hold for one of Africa's most powerful industrial empires? In this exclusive conversation on Bloomberg Next Africa, Halima, Mariya, and Fatima Dangote sit down to discuss the next generation of leadership at the Dangote Group — from expanding cement production and investing in refining, fertilizer and power to building a family office focused on preserving the family’s legacy for generations. They also discuss creating more value from Africa’s resources at home, the role of partnerships and investment, and plans for a pan-African IPO of the Dangote refinery. Discover how Aliko Dangote’s daughters plan to carry forward their father's legacy through strategic growth, diversification, and long-term wealth preservation. (Source: Bloomberg)</article>

items.title: Chinese Chipmaker CXMT Sues Pentagon to Get Off US Blacklist
items.author: Ville Heiskanen
items.content: <article>CXMT Corp. filed a lawsuit against the US Department of Defense, seeking removal from a blacklist that identified the Chinese chipmaker as a supporter of the Communist country’s military.</article>

items.title: OpenAI to End Partnership With Cursor After SpaceX Acquisition
items.author: Yi Wei Wong
items.content: <article>OpenAI said it will end its partnership with Cursor after the AI-coding agent’s acquisition by SpaceX, according to a post on X.</article>
